name: Apex Hunter
description: Increased crit chance vs full HP enemies.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Significant damage boost, but your {resource} ceiling is capped.
notes: The cap REPLACES max energy outright (natural v2 max starts at 100 and only grows, so the cap always binds) — taking it mid-run spills any energy above the new ceiling. Energy doubles as the HP bar AND the movement budget in v2, so this trades both survivability and floor range for damage. Enhancing RAISES the ceiling.

name: Sharp Blade
description: Increase all damage dealt.

name: Berserker
description: Deal bonus damage when low on {resource}.

name: Cleave
description: Adjacent enemies take a portion of damage dealt.

name: Poison Blade
description: Chance to inflict Poison, dealing 20% max HP over time.
notes: 20% of non-boss enemies' max HP per tick for 2 ticks.

name: Critical Boost
description: Chance to deal a critical hit.

name: Frenzy
description: Kills add a damage bonus.

name: Merciless
description: Deal bonus damage to enemies below 50% HP.

name: Reach
description: Strikes hit a second target in a straight line.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Increase attack at the cost of 1 {resource} per strike.

name: Apex Guard
description: Take reduced damage from full HP enemies' first hit.
notes: Ambush cushion (out-of-vision bats, archers, mimic openers) — one reduced hit per enemy, only while the attacker is at full HP. Does not work on trap damage.

name: Divine Shield
description: Chance to block an incoming hit.
notes: Does not work on trap damage.

name: Armor Plating
description: Reduce a portion of all incoming damage.

name: Thorns
description: Reflect a portion of incoming damage back to attackers.

name: Greed
description: Earn more treasure, but take more damage.
notes: Back after the per-floor budget rework removed it, rebuilt to fit it: Greed scales the floor BUDGET at generation time (see GREED_TREASURE_MULT + DungeonGenerator.allocateFloorTreasure), not the value of a drop as it is collected, so the full-clear invariant holds at budget x mult and the drops on the ground already show the bigger numbers. Two consequences worth knowing: the multiplier applies from the NEXT floor on (the current floor was stamped before the pick), and the elective sources OUTSIDE the budget (boss chest, gauntlet, the wager rooms) are deliberately untouched — a collection-time cut would have let Greed inflate a ring-race / portal-gambit payout, which is the player betting their own treasure back at themselves.

name: Prospector
description: Increased chance for items to drop from breakables.
notes: First roll for items, then for other contents?

name: Scavenger
description: Increased chance for breakables to drop loot.
notes: Less breakables + have to have rarity distinction.

name: Swift Steps
description: Gain free moves at the start of each floor.

name: Survival Instinct
description: Gain free moves when dropping below 10 {resource}.
notes: Once per floor. Show used state on Talent.

name: Momentum
description: Kills grant a free move.

name: Last Stand
description: Survive a fatal blow and recover {resource}. Once per floor.
notes: Once per floor. Show used state on Talent.

name: Vampiric
description: Kills restore {resource}.

name: Salvage
description: Smashing breakables restores {resource}.

name: Renewal
description: Gain {resource} at the start of each floor.

name: Scout
description: Increase your vision range.

name: Corruption
description: Chance to corrupt a non-boss enemy on strike.
notes: Corrupted enemy attacks the nearest other enemy. No effect on bosses.

name: Disrupt
description: Chance to stun an enemy for 1 turn on strike.
notes: Stunned enemies skip their next turn.

name: Menace
description: Kills have a chance to frighten adjacent enemies.
notes: Frightened enemies flee in fear for 2 turns.
